title: Lang Co in a day
summary: The beach in the morning, a look at Lập An from the bank, oysters on the lagoon, and Hải Vân Quan by the pass road. The tunnel does not count as the gate.

stops.name: Lang Co Beach
stops.note: Swim and walk the sand while the ridge is in the light.

stops.name: Lap An Lagoon
stops.note: Look at the oyster lines from the bank, and step onto the sand strip only at a strong low tide.

stops.name: Hau nuong trui
stops.note: Eat oysters grilled over the fire on Đầm Lập An.

stops.name: Hai Van Gate
stops.note: Walk the restored gate by the pass road, not the tunnel, for 70,000 VND a person, using the 07:00–17:30 window.

seoTitle: Lang Co in a day — beach, lagoon, and the gate
seoDescription: A Lang Co day: the beach under Hải Vân, a look at Lập An, oysters on the lagoon, and the gate by the pass road.
